instruction: Have I returned any violin on amazon in this year? Say yes or no.
notes: Read-only question task: no database change is allowed, so all amazon actions are lookups. The agent lists its returns (amazon.show_returns), keeps those created in the current year (2023), and inspects each returned product with amazon.show_product to learn its product_type; the answer is yes iff any such product is a violin. The problem assumes two returns this year (matching the 6-call reference); supervisor-complete-task takes the two distinct checked products as extra record parameters so its precondition covers the goal's product-type-known facts without quantification. The answer object is a single runtime-bound yes/no value.
